notes: MINIMAL REPRO OF THE DETACHED FRAME (reproduced 3 times, 2 sessions). r2: `nav https://www.kayak.com --settle` (seq 25), `nav https://www.kayak.com/stays --settle` (seq 27), `snap` (seq 29, lists [#32] div 'Enter a city, hotel, airport, address or landmark'), `click 32` (seq 31). Result: exit 1, 'Click failed: Attempted to use detached Frame 2529FB13...'. `text` on the same page (seq 33) works. A redirect is NOT required (r1 also reproduced via /hotels/Rome,Italy/... redirecting to /stays, seq 7). r1 further: a re-snap returned 'Interactive elements (0)' (seq 9, a silently empty snapshot) and click 32 again gave detached Frame with a different frame id (seq 11). CONTROL: `clickrole button 'Enter a city, hotel, airport, address or landmark'` succeeded (seq 13); the next snap showed [#31] input 'Destination'. But `type 31 Rome` (seq 19) AND CSS-selector `type input[placeholder^='Enter a city'] Rome` (seq 21) both failed with detached Frame (new frame id each call). So the destination cannot be entered on /stays: node-id and CSS-selector element actions fail while role-based click and text reads work. Hypothesis from the independent channel: kayak.com/stays has 4 iframes, one with src 'https://www.kayak.com/stays' (the same URL as the top document) and one 'https://www.kayak.com/ugtm/stays'. Sutradhar's frame resolution for snapshot-id/selector actions likely binds to the same-URL child iframe, which is repeatedly torn down and recreated. Contrast: on /hotels (a2 of the original run) node-id clicks and selector-type worked. Phase 1 SUTRADHAR-FAIL confirmed.
